name: Li Andersson - Annexe I, § 11 - Am 40
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on guidelines for the employment policies of the Member States
part_text: Member States should prioritise the employment, training and reskilling of their national workforce, particularly young people, the long-term unemployed and economically inactive persons, before resorting to the admission of third-country nationals for the purpose of employment, subject to temporary and time-limited residence and work authorisations. Labour shortages should primarily be addressed through better wages, improved working conditions and investment in domestic skills. Decisions on labour migration and access to national labour markets must remain under the control of Member States, while ensuring respect for applicable labour rights.
